rubric.provenance: AI-authored synthetic business judgements; no human expert or participant
rubric.eligibility: Same chosen pool, visible, explicit matching consent, exact specialization, category at least the role minimum, every mandatory skill evidenced by a current or honest historical record. No inferred framework/database equivalence. A revoked-only category cannot establish eligibility.
rubric.privacy: Hidden, non-consenting and cross-pool profiles cannot be disclosed even when technically strong.

relevance.0: Ineligible or no meaningful fit; excluded candidates never count as relevant.
relevance.1: Only minimum plausible fit: fragile same-category result or substantial contextual/staleness limitations.
relevance.2: Useful but limited: moderate same-category evidence, missing desired criterion, uncertain historical quality or contextual cost.
relevance.3: Strong substantive role fit with convincing comparable evidence and at most a bounded limitation.
relevance.4: Exceptional role-specific evidence: very strong current comparable result plus all desired criteria and suitable working conditions, or strong complementary verified FSP.

judgementRules: Labels are explicit row judgements, not a weighted matcher score or a numeric threshold-to-label conversion. Same observed result can have different relevance for different role/context/provenance.
Within the same grade/version/rubric, stronger successful answers can support stronger confidence. Results across grades/versions are never normalized onto a common test scale.
An advanced category may provide substantive value for the role; the production technical group priority is intentionally not assumed by the relevance rubric.
Missing FSP creates no adverse inference. Confirmed FSP can corroborate relevant work, but cannot replace a required skill.
Full mandatory coverage is admission, desired coverage affects substantive relevance. Salary and work format are context, not an admission gate.
Historical records remain honestly eligible where category/skills are preserved but their unknown comparable quality must not be invented.

No numeric weights were selected by looking at measured matcher output. A proposed policy was received from the implementation agent before final serialization; labels were drafted separately and do not adopt its technical group priority.
rubric.holdout: Scenario-level control-holdout authored before ranking implementation/evaluation; synthetic construct check, not statistical unseen-market or independent-human holdout. It becomes consumed when the final report is viewed; no tuning from it is authorized.
